description: Calculate monthly National Insurance and health-insurance contributions for a salaried employee from a gross monthly salary (form 102, row 1: Israeli residents aged 18 up to retirement age). Returns employee and employer amounts, split at the reduced-rate ceiling. Approved tax years: 2026. Excludes income tax, advances, and every other row of the contribution table (controlling shareholders, above retirement age, foreign residents, kibbutzim, soldiers, early pensioners). Not tax advice.

monthly_salary.description: Gross monthly salary in NIS (one month; not an annual figure)

tax_year.description: Tax year of the rates. Approved tax years: 2026. Row 1 only (Israeli residents aged 18 up to retirement age). Any other year is refused.
